name: kuhn-quality-baseline-corpus
description: Synthetic scientific-writing evaluation corpus for the pre-migration quality baseline (STH-31). Every name, trial, drug, statistic, person, and identifier in this corpus is fictional. PMIDs follow the numeric shape of real PubMed IDs but do not resolve on the live service; the baseline runner serves them from the literature fixture and never contacts the network.

files.role: grounding source for manuscript statistics (writer-manuscript-section, writer-narrow-edit)
manuscript draft with planted flaws (reviewer-manuscript-critique, writer-narrow-edit)
fixture literature: PMID metadata, search query map (ra-literature-research, writer-grant-aims, pm-dispatch-subagent)
